Component reads RouteMission.RouteStage/RouteComplete via GetComponent on the GameObject named "RouteMission"; writes nothing to LoopSignals, CourierMission, RouteMission, or Combat. revised_plan.next_objective: THREE-POINT RELAY ACTIVATION — after RouteStage==2 is latched, find the RouteMission component instance; when its RouteComplete==true, arm this stage (armT set from Time.time). Player must press F within 1.5m of three cloned dumpster-mesh "relay boxes" placed at fixed scene coordinates IN ORDER (indices 0→1→2). Correct order: box tinted teal with increasing emission intensity per activation. Wrong-order press: ActivationCount resets to 0, pressed box flashes red 0.3s (visible but non-destructive). Deadline expiry sets Failed=true (own field). All three in order sets AllComplete=true and all boxes turn solid green emission.

revised_plan.positive_and_red_native_proof: GREEN (correct sequence): F at box 0 → ActivationCount=1, box-0 material emission teal intensified. F at box 1 → count=2. F at box 2 → count=3, AllComplete=true, all three boxes emission green (0.1,0.9,0.3), HUD text "RELAY COMPLETE". No LoopSignals mutated. RED (wrong order): Start count=0, press F at box-2 first → count stays 0, box-2 material flashes red for 0.3s then returns to idle, ActivationCount remains 0. RED (deadline): let 45s elapse without completing → Failed=true (own bool), HUD shows "RELAY FAILED — R to retry". Pressing R increments Restarts, component detects change and fully resets ActivationCount=0, Failed=false, AllComplete=false, box materials to idle. No write to Health or Mission signals.

Material: new Material(Shader.Find("Standard")) per clone; swap color/emission on state change. Bootstrap addition: one line after RouteMission.Install(...): RelaySequence.Install(player, cam);

revised_plan.varied_pacing_and_expansion: Honest timing: current full courier route (grab→drive→deliver→east cache) = 36s verified. This relay adds ~20-30s of on-foot ordered navigation (three stops, ~8m apart, requiring route planning). Combined ~56-66s. Still far from 540-660s target. Path to 540s requires: (Phase 1) relay = +25s, (Phase 2) connected eastward expansion providing ≥150m new traversal with enterable structure = +120-180s, (Phase 3) a final chapter objective within that expansion = +150-200s, (Phase 4) combat encounters requiring actual damage proof = +60-100s. Each phase is a separate increment; none can be claimed until physically placed and walkover-measured. The relay is a valid isolated increment because its 3-point routing creates replay variance (player-chosen clockwise vs counter-clockwise) without adding new meshes beyond one clone mesh.
